items.title: Pay outstanding debt plus interest and legal fees
items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den Gesamtbetrag bis spätestens Mittwoch, 25.02.2026 auf unser Kanzleikonto zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date, not a period to be counted: 'bis spätestens Mittwoch, 25.02.2026'. The sender is a private law firm, not a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery or §187/188/193 BGB counting is needed — the printed calendar date is the due date itself. Cross-check of the weekday: 2026-01-01 is a Thursday; 2026-02-25 is 55 days later (55 mod 7 = 6, Thursday+6=Wednesday), confirming 2026-02-25 is indeed a Wednesday as printed, so the date is internally consistent. Payment must reach the firm's account by (i.e. no later than) 2026-02-25.

warnings: This is a pre-litigation demand letter from a law firm acting for the creditor (Malerbetrieb Beispielfarbe GmbH); it threatens court action without further notice if the deadline of 25.02.2026 is missed, so verify the underlying invoice (R-2025-318) and the debt are genuinely owed before paying.

The IBAN given (DE79 3705 0198 0005 5407 00, Musterbank AG) is well-formed, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership — confirm via the firm's official contact details that this is really their client account before transferring money, especially since the sum includes added interest and the firm's own statutory fee (Nr. 2300, 7002 VV RVG).
